_comment: Seat inventory for the four sponsor seats. ONE seat is sold once and renders on BOTH dsh.works and dshthemes.com, so this file is the single home for it — dshthemes fetches it from here at build time (scripts/sponsors.mjs) and caches it. Hand-edited; there is no CMS and there does not need to be. A seat is sold for a term and the dates are printed on the site, so an expired seat is visible rather than quietly renewed. `checkout` is the Stripe Payment Link for one seat term; while it is null every seat links to `terms` instead of a checkout that does not exist. `terms` MUST be absolute — dshthemes.com renders the same value and has no /sponsor page. `price` stays the single headline figure because dshthemes' loader validates on `price.said`; a seat may override it with its own `price`, which is how the annual seat is priced differently from the three monthly ones. `sale.until` is a real deadline printed on the page: when it passes, edit this file. NOTHING in this file may reference a plugin slug, a theme, a tag, or any registry field: a seat buys the box, and the box is not part of the dataset.

sale.why: The board is new and the projects behind it ship every week. Early seats are cheap because they are early, not because the space is worth less.
